reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it in a sachet to go. A foil pack a day for $0.83 is more than I want to pay for something I already have a bottle of.
objection: I already have magnesium at home and I take it there. Paying extra for portability I won't use doesn't make sense, and I'd forget it half the time anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A real flash sale or coupon that brings it clearly under what I pay per day now, or if my current bottle ran out and this was cheaper per day.
